title: The host carries ~5,700 sessions, mostly finished, inflating every full-state build and broadcast
outcome: Finished sessions (especially completed delegation children) no longer inflate live state. They're archived or excluded from the live state projection under a documented retention rule, and stay retrievable on demand.
acceptance: A read-only measurement note breaks down the host's sessions by kind and status (root vs delegation child; active, idle, finished or archived) and their share of the full-state snapshot bytes, on the live host count.

A documented retention rule moves unobserved quiescent finished sessions out of the live state projection (archived or hidden, still retrievable via existing history/detail routes), covered by tests that an unwatched quiescent finished child disappears from the live snapshot while its result and transcript stay readable and its parent's delegation record still resolves; a watched one stays an ordinary member until its last watch ends, then disappears the same way provided it is still quiescent.

On the same session set the full-state snapshot size drops by the measured share, recorded in a note, and cargo test --bin termal plus the UI vitest suite are green; no deletion of transcripts or results.
